description: Climate Change Response Framework is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Northern Institute of Applied Climate Science; U.S. Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA); NPS, U.S. National Park Service. This framework helps bridge the gap between scientific research on climate change impacts and on-the-ground natural resource management. The framework was designed as a model for collaborative climate change response across large and diverse landscapes, providing a broad approach that can be adjusted and applied to other locations and landscapes. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
